data.description: In any condition of illumination other than full daylight, a shadow mastiff disappears into the shadows, giving it total concealment. Artificial illumination, even a Light or Continual Flame spell, does not negate this ability. A Daylight spell, however, will. A shadow mastiff can suspend or resume this ability as a free action.
data.name: Shadow Blend
